_comment: ALT-R&B comping patterns (voicing space). Rhythm archetypes from ../../docs/idiom-research/genre-funk-soul-rnb.md section C3 (Rhodes float, gospel chop-anticipation, two-chord shimmer); voicing realizations original. Rootless9 is the house voicing -- section C8 lists plain triads and plain V7 as the genre error, so triads appear nowhere here. Gaps are the content: the sparse patterns leave one to two full beats of silence per bar, and the busiest one still rests through most of beat 3. No glide -- the validator forbids it on comping because pitch bend is per channel and would smear the whole voicing.

provenance.inspiration: style of the neo-soul Rhodes float: one soft rootless 9th voicing held nearly the whole bar, re-struck quietly on the and of 4 to lean into the next chord (original)
style of the two-hit alt-R&B pad that matches the pack's sparsepad groove: the downbeat and a syncopated push on the and of 3, both allowed to ring (original)
style of the gospel-R&B keyboard chop: a three-quarter downbeat, a short answer on the and of 2, a second chop on 3, and an anticipation on the and of 4 that arrives before the change does (original)

style of two-bar alt-R&B keys shimmer: bar one hangs a voicing with the 9th pinned on top, bar two answers with the 11th on top and a low drop-2 tail, so the colour moves while the chord does not (original)
style of the busiest alt-R&B keys pattern that still breathes: an accented downbeat, a clipped 16th answer, a muted scratch under beat 3, and a shell tag on the last 16th (original)
